requirements.title: Principal identification
requirements.statement: Every protected operation MUST be attributable to an authenticated principal or explicitly identified anonymous context.

requirements.title: Explicit trust domains
requirements.statement: Implementations MUST document trust domains and MUST NOT infer trust from network location, repository ownership, discovery, or prior interaction alone.

requirements.title: Default-deny authorization
requirements.statement: Protected operations MUST be denied when no applicable allow decision exists or when the policy decision cannot be obtained and verified.

requirements.title: Least-privilege capability scope
requirements.statement: Granted capabilities MUST be scoped by action and resource and SHOULD be bounded by time, audience, and delegation depth.

requirements.title: Credential lifecycle
requirements.statement: Credential-bearing implementations MUST define issuance, expiry, rotation, revocation, and compromise response.

requirements.title: Schema validation
requirements.statement: Untrusted structured input MUST be validated against a declared, versioned schema before it influences privileged behavior.

requirements.title: Manifest is not authorization
requirements.statement: Resource manifests MUST describe resources and MUST NOT be interpreted as grants of permission or proof of trust.

requirements.title: Security audit events
requirements.statement: Implementations MUST emit structured audit events for authentication, authorization decisions, privilege changes, security configuration changes, and protected actions.

requirements.title: Audit integrity limits
requirements.statement: Audit integrity mechanisms MUST document their trust anchor and MUST NOT claim that hashing alone proves event truth, completeness, or independent witnessing.

requirements.title: Release provenance
requirements.statement: Released software artifacts SHOULD be accompanied by an SBOM and verifiable build provenance, and MUST document signature verification expectations.

requirements.title: No secret material in source
requirements.statement: Repositories MUST NOT contain live credentials, private keys, access tokens, or production secret values; use a dedicated secrets manager and short-lived identity where supported.

requirements.title: Security failure behavior
requirements.statement: When required identity, authorization, revocation, or integrity checks fail, protected operations MUST fail closed and MUST NOT silently downgrade security.
